name: 艾森克人格问卷
instructions: 以下是一些关于您行为和感受的问题。请根据您的实际情况回答“是”或“否”。请尽快作答，不要过多思考。
instructionsEn: The following questions are about your behavior and feelings. Please answer “Yes” or “No” according to how things actually are for you. Answer as quickly as possible without thinking too much.
license: Eysenck 编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 你是否有许多不同的业余爱好？
items.textEn: Do you have many different hobbies?

items.text: 你是否在做任何事情以前都要停下来仔细思考？
items.textEn: Do you stop to think carefully before doing anything?

items.text: 你的心境是否常有起伏？
items.textEn: Is your mood very changeable?

items.text: 你曾有过明知是别人的功劳而你去接受奖励的事吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever taken credit for work that you knew was really someone else’s?

items.text: 你是否健谈？
items.textEn: Are you a talkative person?

items.text: 欠债会使你不安吗？
items.textEn: Would being in debt make you uneasy?

items.text: 你曾无缘无故觉得“真是难受”吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever felt really miserable for no reason?

items.text: 你曾经贪图过份外之物吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever coveted something that was not yours?

items.text: 你是否在晚上小心翼翼地关好门窗？
items.textEn: Do you carefully lock the doors and windows at night?

items.text: 你是否比较活跃？
items.textEn: Are you a fairly active person?

items.text: 你在见到一小孩或一动物受折磨时是否会感到非常难过？
items.textEn: Would you feel very upset if you saw a child or an animal being tortured?

items.text: 你是否常常为自己不该做而做了的事、不该说而说了的话而紧张吗？
items.textEn: Do you often feel nervous about things you did or said that you should not have?

items.text: 你喜欢跳降落伞吗？
items.textEn: Do you like parachuting?

items.text: 通常你能在热闹联欢会中尽情地玩吗？
items.textEn: Do you usually enjoy yourself thoroughly at a lively party?

items.text: 你容易激动吗？
items.textEn: Are you easily excited?

items.text: 你曾经将自己的过错推给别人吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever blamed someone else for your own mistake?

items.text: 你喜欢会见陌生人吗？
items.textEn: Do you like meeting strangers?

items.text: 你是否相信保险制度是一种好办法？
items.textEn: Do you think insurance is a good idea?

items.text: 你是一个容易伤感情的人吗？
items.textEn: Are your feelings easily hurt?

items.text: 你所有的习惯都是好的吗？
items.textEn: Are all your habits good ones?

items.text: 在社交场合你是否总不愿露头角？
items.textEn: In social situations do you always avoid standing out?

items.text: 你会服用有奇异或危险作用的药物吗？
items.textEn: Would you take drugs that have strange or dangerous effects?

items.text: 你常有“厌倦”之感吗？
items.textEn: Do you often feel fed up?

items.text: 你曾拿过别人的东西（哪怕是一针一线）吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever taken something from someone else, however trivial?

items.text: 你是否常爱外出？
items.textEn: Do you like going out often?

items.text: 你是否从伤害你所宠爱的人而感到乐趣？
items.textEn: Do you enjoy hurting the people you care about?

items.text: 你常为有罪恶之感所苦恼吗？
items.textEn: Are you often troubled by feelings of guilt?

items.text: 你在谈论中是否有时不懂装懂？
items.textEn: Do you sometimes pretend to understand when you do not?

items.text: 你是否宁愿去看些书而不愿去多见人？
items.textEn: Would you rather read a book than meet people?

items.text: 你有要伤害你的仇人吗？
items.textEn: Do you ever want to hurt your enemies?

items.text: 你觉得自己是一个神经过敏的人吗？
items.textEn: Do you consider yourself a nervous person?

items.text: 对人有所失礼时你是否经常要表示歉意？
items.textEn: When you have been rude to someone, do you often apologize?

items.text: 你有许多朋友吗？
items.textEn: Do you have many friends?

items.text: 你是否喜爱讲些有时确能伤害人的笑话？
items.textEn: Do you enjoy telling jokes that can sometimes really hurt people?

items.text: 你是一个多忧多虑的人吗？
items.textEn: Are you a worrier?

items.text: 你在童年是否按照吩咐要做什么便做什么，毫无怨言？
items.textEn: When you were a child, did you do as you were told without complaining?

items.text: 你认为你是一个乐天派吗？
items.textEn: Do you consider yourself an optimist?

items.text: 你很讲究礼貌和整洁吗？
items.textEn: Are you very particular about good manners and cleanliness?

items.text: 你是否总在担心会发生可怕的事情？
items.textEn: Are you always worried that something terrible will happen?

items.text: 你曾损坏或遗失过别人的东西吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever broken or lost something that belonged to someone else?

items.text: 交新朋友时一般是你采取主动吗？
items.textEn: When making new friends, do you usually take the initiative?

items.text: 当别人向你诉苦时，你是否容易理解他们的苦衷？
items.textEn: When people tell you their troubles, do you easily understand how they feel?

items.text: 你认为自己很紧张，如同“拉紧的弦”一样吗？
items.textEn: Do you think of yourself as very tense, like a tightly stretched string?

items.text: 在没有废纸篓时，你是否将废纸扔在地板上？
items.textEn: When there is no waste paper basket, do you throw waste paper on the floor?

items.text: 当你与别人在一起时，你是否言语很少？
items.textEn: When you are with other people, do you talk very little?

items.text: 你是否认为结婚制度是过时了，应该废止？
items.textEn: Do you think marriage is out of date and should be abolished?

items.text: 你是否有时感到自己可怜？
items.textEn: Do you sometimes feel sorry for yourself?

items.text: 你是否有时有点自夸？
items.textEn: Do you sometimes boast a little?

items.text: 你是否很容易将一个沉寂的集会搞得活跃起来？
items.textEn: Can you easily liven up a dull party?

items.text: 你是否讨厌那种小心翼翼地开车的人？
items.textEn: Do you dislike people who drive very carefully?

items.text: 你为你的健康担忧吗？
items.textEn: Do you worry about your health?

items.text: 你曾讲过什么人的坏话吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever spoken ill of anyone?

items.text: 你是否喜欢对朋友讲笑话和有趣的故事？
items.textEn: Do you like telling jokes and funny stories to your friends?

items.text: 你小时曾对父母粗暴无礼吗？
items.textEn: Were you ever rude to your parents as a child?

items.text: 你是否喜欢与人混在一起？
items.textEn: Do you like mixing with people?

items.text: 你如知道自己工作有错误，这会使你感到难过吗？
items.textEn: If you knew you had made a mistake in your work, would it make you feel upset?

items.text: 你患失眠吗？
items.textEn: Do you suffer from insomnia?

items.text: 你吃饭前必定洗手吗？
items.textEn: Do you always wash your hands before eating?

items.text: 你常无缘无故感到无精打采和倦怠吗？
items.textEn: Do you often feel listless and tired for no reason?

items.text: 和别人玩游戏时，你有过欺骗行为吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever cheated when playing games with other people?

items.text: 你是否喜欢从事一些动作迅速的工作？
items.textEn: Do you like doing work that requires quick action?

items.text: 你的母亲是一位善良的妇人吗？
items.textEn: Is your mother a kind-hearted woman?

items.text: 你是否常常觉得人生非常无味？
items.textEn: Do you often feel that life is very dull?

items.text: 你曾利用过某人为自己取得好处吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever used someone to gain an advantage for yourself?

items.text: 你是否常常参加许多活动，超过你的时间所允许？
items.textEn: Do you often take part in more activities than you have time for?

items.text: 是否有几个人总在躲避你？
items.textEn: Are there several people who always avoid you?

items.text: 你是否为你的容貌而非常烦恼？
items.textEn: Are you very worried about your appearance?

items.text: 你是否觉得人们为了未来有保障而办理储蓄和保险所花的时间太多？
items.textEn: Do you think people spend too much time on savings and insurance to secure their future?

items.text: 你曾有过不如死了为好的愿望吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever wished you were dead?

items.text: 如果有把握永远不会被人发现，你会逃税吗？
items.textEn: If you were sure you would never be found out, would you avoid paying taxes?

items.text: 你能使一个集会顺利进行吗？
items.textEn: Can you keep a party running smoothly?

items.text: 你能克制自己不对人无礼吗？
items.textEn: Can you keep yourself from being rude to people?

items.text: 遇到一次难堪的经历以后，你是否在一段长时间内还感到难受？
items.textEn: After an embarrassing experience, do you still feel upset for a long time?

items.text: 你患有“神经过敏”吗？
items.textEn: Do you suffer from nerves?

items.text: 你曾经故意说些什么来伤害别人的感情吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever said something deliberately to hurt someone’s feelings?

items.text: 你与别人的友谊是否容易破裂，虽然不是你的过错？
items.textEn: Do your friendships break down easily, even when it is not your fault?

items.text: 你常感到孤单吗？
items.textEn: Do you often feel lonely?

items.text: 当人家寻你的差错、找你工作中的缺点时，你是否容易在精神上受挫伤？
items.textEn: When people find fault with your work, are you easily hurt by it?

items.text: 你赴约会或上班曾迟到过吗？
items.textEn: Have you ever been late for an appointment or for work?

items.text: 你喜欢忙忙碌碌和热热闹闹过日子吗？
items.textEn: Do you like living a busy and lively life?

items.text: 你愿意别人怕你吗？
items.textEn: Would you like other people to be afraid of you?

items.text: 你是否觉得有时浑身是劲，而有时又是懒洋洋的吗？
items.textEn: Do you sometimes feel full of energy and at other times completely lazy?

items.text: 你有时把今天应做的事拖到明天去做吗？
items.textEn: Do you sometimes leave until tomorrow what you should do today?

items.text: 别人认为你是生气勃勃的吗？
items.textEn: Do other people think you are lively and full of energy?

items.text: 别人是否对你说了许多谎话？
items.textEn: Have other people told you many lies?

items.text: 你是否对某些事物容易冒火？
items.textEn: Do you easily get angry about certain things?

items.text: 当你犯了错误时，你是否常常愿意承认它？
items.textEn: When you make a mistake, are you usually willing to admit it?

items.text: 你会为一动物落入圈套被捉拿而感到很难过吗？
items.textEn: Would you feel very upset if an animal were caught in a trap?

bands.description: 外向性得分较低，性格偏内向，喜欢独处和安静的环境。
外向性处于中等水平，在社交和独处之间能够平衡。
外向性得分较高，性格偏外向，喜欢社交和热闹的场合。
神经质得分较低，情绪较为稳定，不易受到外界影响。
神经质处于中等水平，情绪稳定性一般。
神经质得分较高，情绪波动较大，容易感到焦虑和不安。
精神质得分较低，社会适应良好，行为符合常规。
精神质处于中等水平，有一定的非传统倾向。
精神质得分较高，可能表现出非传统的行为方式和思维方式。
掩饰性得分较低，作答较为真实可信。
掩饰性处于中等水平，可能存在一定的社会期望效应。
掩饰性得分较高，作答可能受到社会期望影响，结果需谨慎解释。
